newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office Products to buy 30 companies.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office Products to buy 30 companies.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co., an office products supplier, said Thursday it plans to acquire 30 companies for about $208 million in stock and $61 million in cash.

The companies have about $605 million in total revenues, U.S. Office said, and are expected to add to the company's future earnings. Should all 30 companies be acquired, U.S. Office said they will increase the firm's business to about $2.9 billion.

U.S. Office said among the acquisitions was closely-held Bay State Computer Group, which will allow it to offer computer and telecommunications network services while also expanding into the forms management business through select acquisitions.

The company said in a statement it sees "enormous opportunities to cross-sell products like forms management and computer services with our traditional contract office supply, office furniture, and office coffee service businesses."
U.S. Office added that "we believe that we will quickly have over $100 million in annual forms management sales starting next quarter."

In addition to Bay State Computer, four other of the acquisitions have been completed: Landmark Stationers (New York, N.Y.), Bender & Sons (Pollocksville, N.C.), Lincoln Office Supply Company (Waterloo, Iowa) and Wellington Business Equipment (New Zealand).
The remaining 25 transactions are subject to the completion of definitive agreements and, in some cases, federal antitrust clearance. The company would not identify the remaining acquisitions.
U.S. Office stock was up 50 cents at $35.50 on Nasdaq in afternoon trading.
